description: The server assigns the agent a new instance UID: after a restart with the same chosen UID, the agent goes on with the assigned one. The first run is long: the UID is assigned in reply to the second message, and on a cold, busy ARC runner a JVM client's first message has taken 6 s. The second run is long too: a Java client on such a runner has taken more than 4 s from its start to its first message.
